faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Thoothukudi District Health Society Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies in total: Therapeutic Assistants (NAMMSD) 2, Therapeutic Assistant (NRHM Yoga) 1, AYUSH Medical Officer 1, Dispenser (Siddha Pharmacist) 1 and AYUSH Multi purpose Hospital Worker 2.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date shown in the notice is 04.12.2026 (4 December 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Therapeutic Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Diploma in Nursing Therapy (DNT), a 2-year course approved by the Directorate of Indian Medicine and Homeopathy, for both Therapeutic Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for AYUSH Medical Officer and Dispenser?
faq.answer: AYUSH Medical Officer requires BSMS. Dispenser (Siddha Pharmacist) requires a Diploma in Pharmacy.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age column shows 59 for the first four posts and 18 and 40 for AYUSH Multi purpose Hospital Worker.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for AYUSH Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The AYUSH Medical Officer pay shown is Rs.40000/-. Other posts: Therapeutic Assistants Rs.15000/- (NAMMSD) and Rs.17000/- (NRHM Yoga), Dispenser Rs.18000/-, Multi purpose Hospital Worker Rs.11,000 /-.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the posts be located?
faq.answer: Posts are at Government Head Quarters Hospital, Vilathikulam, and Primary Health Centres at Pitchivilai, Kulathur, Authoor, Keelachekkarakudi and Veppalodai.
